questions.question_en: How many Indian states share a border with Assam?
questions.question_as: কিমানখন ভাৰতীয় ৰাজ্যই অসমৰ সৈতে সীমা ভাগ বতৰা কৰে?
questions.answer_en: Six Indian states - Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Meghalaya and West Bengal.
questions.answer_as: ছয়খন ভাৰতীয় ৰাজ্য - অৰুণাচল প্ৰদেশ, নাগালেণ্ড, মণিপুৰ, মিজোৰাম, মেঘালয় আৰু পশ্চিম বংগ।

questions.question_en: With which states does Assam have long-standing border disputes?

questions.answer_en: Nagaland, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh and Mizoram.
questions.answer_as: নাগালেণ্ড, মেঘালয়, অৰুণাচল প্ৰদেশ আৰু মিজোৰাম।

questions.question_en: How many areas of disagreement are there in the Assam-Meghalaya border dispute, and how many were settled through the 2022 Memorandum of Understanding?
questions.question_as: অসম-মেঘালয় সীমা বিবাদত কিমানটা অঞ্চলৰ মতভেদ আছে, আৰু ২০২২ চনৰ বুজাবুজি-পত্ৰৰ জৰিয়তে কিমানটা অঞ্চল মীমাংসা হৈছে?
questions.answer_en: 12 areas of disagreement; 6 areas were settled through the 2022 Memorandum of Understanding.
questions.answer_as: ১২টা অঞ্চলৰ মতভেদ আছে; ২০২২ চনৰ বুজাবুজি-পত্ৰৰ জৰিয়তে ৬টা অঞ্চল মীমাংসা হৈছে।

questions.question_en: Which areas are associated with the Assam-Nagaland border dispute?

questions.answer_en: Several areas such as Merapani, as well as the Rengma reserved forest areas.
questions.answer_as: মেৰাপাণিৰ দৰে কেইবাটাও অঞ্চল, লগতে ৰেঙমা সংৰক্ষিত বনাঞ্চল।

questions.question_en: Does Assam have a bicameral or unicameral legislature?

questions.answer_en: Bicameral - it has a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council.
questions.answer_as: দ্বিকক্ষীয় - অসমত বিধানসভা আৰু বিধান পৰিষদ আছে।
